entry.note: Existing CI definitions invoke offline tests, provenance/version/stdout/wire gates and 70-percent branch coverage. Neither those gates nor these tests were run for this markup task.

GAPS.gap: No core assertions pin complete facade exports/version or prove imports remain usable without optional browser packages.

No direct core base-envelope, stderr JSON or stdout-purity assertions found. Runtime caplog checks are indirect logging coverage, not wire capture; source-selection assertions are mapped from marketplace-connector tests separately.
Core assertions do not comprehensively pin all error codes, ToolError JSON mapping, timeout options/cache or HTTP status classification; Retry-After HTTP-date paths are not asserted in test_http.py.

Inspected core runtime tests use fake FastMCP launch. Actual request-level bearer/tenant middleware rejection, session resolution and loaded/unloaded handoff lifespan cleanup are not directly asserted here; no real stdio/HTTP serving or TLS test.
No inspected cache test stores None or exercises factory exception/cancellation recovery. Timing uses injected clocks; real event-loop/source pacing efficacy and refusal recovery are not established.

Property tests sample specified strategies, not every possible payload. Core tests do not directly cover all deep_first/offer-validation/meta/widget paths. DOM helper assertions mostly inspect generated strings or Python tile mapping; jsdom UTF-8 tests can skip and do not prove live browser layout behavior.

Tree termination is mocked rather than a real Windows/POSIX process-tree proof. Redaction recognizes known credential shapes, not arbitrary PII/secrets; whitespace-split proxy credentials remain unsupported by source comments.
Registered-tool examples pin current FastMCP internals statically; no cross-version compatibility or real client structuredContent validation was executed.

HTTP tests use mock transports/streams, not live proxies/TLS/HTTP2/marketplace redirects. The budgeted gate is entered before retries only, not before the initial request; its existing test asserts exactly one gate entry after a first failure.

Core browser/network/desktop lifecycles are fake or mocked; no real Chrome autostart, profile exclusivity, Playwright/raw-version interoperability, user-cleared challenge, real screenshot DPI/window activation or end-to-end MCP-session retained-page isolation was observed. Navigation permit cancellation paths are not fully asserted in the inspected budget tests.
All entries are static evidence of existing test intent/assertions, not passing test results. No repository code, tests, gates, browser, network or git command was executed.

No live/cdp-marked tests found in these package inventories. Captured parser_live/live_dom filenames denote offline fixtures, not current upstream or authenticated-browser evidence. Only WB, Detsky Mir and Yandex have live-marked source suites; the other eleven source servers have no live-marked suite, including AliExpress which uses cdp instead.

Live suites were not run. Their selfcheck assertions allow inconclusive and drift_detected, so passing these assertions alone would not establish upstream health. WB additionally requires priced search results, not exact live card/variant price reconciliation.

One actual cdp-marked test exists, not zero. It skips without Chrome and allows missing card price; even a pass would not prove card-price availability or exact search/card reconciliation. No execution here.

Captured DOM/jsdom tests check selectors and price semantics, not real navigation, current markup, login cookies or user-cleared challenges. Optional tooling can skip these assertions. Real browser/profile/IP-dependent behavior is not verified.
Paid auth/quota/analytics endpoint was not called; fake-token transport and saved graphs do not establish current token validity, quota or live warehouse semantics.

Full 40-tool surface requires successful selected imports. Patched skipped-source introspection does not exercise every real optional-dependency failure; no real client mount or live cross-source comparison was performed.

check_provenance skips malformed/missing sha256, unmatched fixture pairs and sidecar-free fixtures; matching existing pins is not proof that every captured fixture has complete provenance. Existing gate tests do not assert these completeness failures.

Workflow definitions and operational regression tests are inspected, not executed release/build/container/publishing evidence. No direct isolated tests of every check_versions/check_no_print/check_coverage_floor branch were identified in the inspected inventories; current version agreement beyond the declaration count is not verified by running the gate.

verification.scope: All 20 core modules and 15 connector packages are mapped to existing inspected tests or explicit gaps. Test-file names do not imply live coverage; assertions and markers determine scope. No git, tests, imports of repository modules, live selfchecks, browser/network probes or release gates were run. Independent static checks compare all 104 Python source ASTs to a pre-edit snapshot and require every source edit to be an insertion of comments/blank lines only; XML parsing and identifier/path checks validate the markup, not runtime behavior.
